verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank. Its public HTTP API is extensively documented across wires, ACH, book transfers, checks, realtime payments, accounts, reporting, webhooks and idempotency. The API is defined by a published OpenAPI spec, confirmed live at /openapi.json by probe, and the docs expose an llms.txt for AI agents. Independent community comments call the documentation 'excellent', and a Column engineer says customers drive it via the HTTP API. A fully sandboxed environment and mode-scoped API keys support safe programmatic use.
